worst: A: omits that 4 of the 9 open-label-extension deaths were deemed possibly related to study treatment, while stating only that no 18-month deaths were related
worst_summary_quote: No deaths in the 18-month double-blind period were related to lecanemab or occurred with ARIA.
worst_page_quote: There were 9 deaths during the OLE, with 4 deemed possibly related to study treatment.
reader_gets_wrong: A reader may judge lecanemab's death safety as clean, missing that 4 of 9 extension deaths were deemed possibly treatment-related, and may not know the absolute CDR-SB difference (1.21 vs 1.66) or the separate ARIA-E (12.6%) and ARIA-H (17.3%) rates.
notes: Core numbers (27%, 21.3 vs 9.3, 2.8%, 26.4 vs 7.4, 24 deaths/3 ICH, tPA=thrombolytic) match pages; 21.3/9.3 found in alzheimer-europe page (search.raw1), not a listed link. Opus scopes the no-related-deaths claim to the 18-month period and avoids sponsor-causality wording, unlike Haiku round.
